description: Add an object to an existing R3 project — a cube, sphere, terrain, lighting, a physics body, and so on. Each factory builds a complete, correctly-wired object (mesh + geometry + material + colour, already connected), so you never assemble components by hand. Kept at once in the project's live copy: every R3 tab with the project open shows it now, no editor needed and nothing to save (r3_editor_create is the same tool). The answer says what was kept and its seq. Use r3_factory_list to see the factories and their options.

params.description: Factory options, e.g. {"color": 16711680, "position": {"y": 2}}. Every option has a default. NOTE: rotation is in RADIANS and color is a packed RGB integer.

projectId.description: The project to add to, from r3_project_create.

name: r3_factory_run

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Add something to an R3 project
